name: @chattermark/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Chattermark (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle signals --output src/.bundled/signals.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle signals --output src/.bundled/signals.json && redocly bundle sources --output src/.bundled/sources.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle sources --output src/.bundled/sources.json && redocly bundle forecasts --output src/.bundled/forecasts.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle forecasts --output src/.bundled/forecasts.json && redocly bundle estate --output src/.bundled/estate.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle estate --output src/.bundled/estate.json && redocly bundle warnings --output src/.bundled/warnings.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle warnings --output src/.bundled/warnings.json && redocly bundle decisions --output src/.bundled/decisions.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle decisions --output src/.bundled/decisions.json && redocly bundle assurance --output src/.bundled/assurance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle assurance --output src/.bundled/assurance.json && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.json
